file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive inventory and categorization of all JSON fields across 7 TradeHub Frappe apps
file_insights.content_structure: Executive summary, distribution table by app, complete field inventory organized by app and DocType with field tables, Python code patterns, and migration recommendations

patterns_discovered.description: All 7 apps use json.loads()/json.dumps() exclusively; no use of frappe.parse_json or frappe.as_json
patterns_discovered.evidence: Consistent pattern across iyzico.py, paytr.py, commission_rule.py, seller_balance.py
patterns_discovered.impact: Error handling is predictable and uniform across codebase

patterns_discovered.description: Commission Rule has 6 JSON fields for seller/category restrictions that store arrays with fixed schema
patterns_discovered.evidence: Fields: restricted_sellers, excluded_sellers, restricted_categories, excluded_categories, day_of_week_restrictions, override_by
patterns_discovered.impact: High-priority MIGRATE candidates - store repeated structured data suitable for child tables with Links for referential integrity

patterns_discovered.description: Dynamic summaries and computed fields (Cart seller_summary, Escrow Account metadata) are intentionally kept as JSON
patterns_discovered.evidence: Cart seller_summary has dynamic seller keys; values recalculated on every change
patterns_discovered.impact: These should stay as JSON to avoid unnecessary normalization overhead

patterns_discovered.description: Order Event and Escrow Event data_json fields store different schema per event_type (status_change, payment, shipping)
patterns_discovered.evidence: Fields: Order Event data_json, Escrow Event event_data
patterns_discovered.impact: Cannot migrate to fixed-schema child table without losing flexibility

patterns_discovered.description: Payment gateway responses (iyzico, paytr) stored as-is with unpredictable provider-specific schemas
patterns_discovered.evidence: Payment Intent gateway_response, fraud_check_response, webhook_response; gateway_config and installment_options vary by provider
patterns_discovered.impact: All external API fields must remain as JSON; provider-specific configurations are intentionally flexible

patterns_discovered.description: Common pattern: try: json.loads(value) except json.JSONDecodeError used consistently
patterns_discovered.evidence: Patterns in payment gateway integration, seller balance, rule engine, review processing
patterns_discovered.impact: Standardized error handling reduces debugging complexity

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: 4 deprecated JSON fields still exist despite having child tables
affected_fields: Listing attributes (DEPRECATED - use Listing Attribute Value table)
Listing images (DEPRECATED - use Listing Image table)
Listing bulk_pricing_tiers (DEPRECATED - use Listing Bulk Pricing Tier table)
Seller Profile badges (DEPRECATED - use Seller Badge table)
gotchas_discovered.action_required: Identify and clean up legacy JSON fields that have been superseded by child tables; may cause confusion in schema

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Provider-specific payment gateway configurations have incompatible schemas
gotchas_discovered.context: Payment Method gateway_config stores iyzico, paytr, stripe configs with different JSON structures
gotchas_discovered.implication: Cannot normalize into fixed-schema child table; must remain as flexible JSON

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Polymorphic event data varies by event_type enumeration
gotchas_discovered.context: Order Event data_json and Escrow Event event_data have different schemas depending on the event_type field value
gotchas_discovered.implication: Would require separate child table per event_type or keep as JSON; normalization is not straightforward

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Seller Tag Rule uses custom DSL with nested AND/OR conditions
gotchas_discovered.context: rule_json field stores dynamic rule engine DSL that cannot be represented in flat/tabular structure
gotchas_discovered.implication: Already has child table Seller Tag Rule Condition for simple conditions, but complex DSL must stay as JSON

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Financial data stored as JSON without ACID guarantees
gotchas_discovered.context: Seller Balance recent_transactions and Payment Intent partial_refunds use append pattern: parse -> modify -> dump
gotchas_discovered.implication: Financial records in JSON lack proper transaction logging; high-priority migration candidates to ensure referential integrity and audit trail

approach_outcome.deliverable: Comprehensive 1283-line inventory document with complete categorization of 73 JSON fields
methodology: Scanned all 7 TradeHub apps for fieldtype='JSON' and fieldtype='Code' with options='JSON'
Created distribution table showing 24 MIGRATE + 48 KEEP categorization
For each field: (a) read DocType JSON schema, (b) read Python controller to find json.loads/json.dumps patterns, (c) categorized as MIGRATE or KEEP with detailed rationale
Identified 4 deprecated fields with existing child tables
Documented common Python patterns for error handling
Provided field-level rationale for all 73 fields
key_findings: No apps use frappe.parse_json - all use python json module
25 fields are clear MIGRATE candidates (structured, repeated data)
48 fields must KEEP as JSON (dynamic, polymorphic, external API responses, configurations)
Commission Rule has 6 high-impact MIGRATE fields for seller/category/role restrictions
Financial data (Seller Balance, Payment Intent) needs migration for audit trail

output_artifact.commit_message: auto-claude: subtask-4-1 - Complete inventory of all JSON fields across all 7 tradehub apps

recommendations.action: Remove 4 deprecated JSON fields that have existing child tables
recommendations.rationale: Reduces schema confusion; prevents dual maintenance of same data

recommendations.action: Migrate Commission Rule restriction/exclusion fields to child tables
recommendations.target_schema: Create child tables with Link fields to Seller Profile, Category, Role respectively
recommendations.rationale: Enables referential integrity, improves query performance, supports ACL-based filtering

recommendations.action: Migrate financial transaction records to child tables for audit trail
recommendations.target_schema: Child tables with audit fields (created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by)
recommendations.rationale: Ensures ACID compliance, enables detailed financial reporting and fraud detection

recommendations.action: Migrate image and media JSON fields to child tables
recommendations.target_schema: Child tables with file attachment support, alt text, sort order
recommendations.rationale: Aligns with existing Listing Image and Review Image patterns; improves media management

recommendations.action: Migrate flags and metadata arrays to child tables
recommendations.target_schema: Child tables with timestamp, user reference, and reason fields
recommendations.rationale: Improves compliance audit trail and data queryability

recommendations.action: Maintain all Code+JSON fields as flexible JSON
recommendations.rationale: These store provider-specific configurations and dynamic rule DSLs that require schema flexibility

recommendations.action: Maintain polymorphic event data as JSON
recommendations.rationale: Event schema varies by event_type; would require complex inheritance model to normalize

recommendations.action: Create policy document for future JSON field approvals
recommendations.guidance: Require migration assessment before adding new JSON fields; establish criteria: if data is structured/repeated/queryable → child table; if dynamic/external/config → JSON
recommendations.rationale: Prevents future schema debt; ensures consistency with this inventory
